GET A FAST QUOTE 904-780-6545 Enclosure Rescreen EXPERTS GET THE BEST Enclosure rescreen services In Saint Augustine, FL Polyester Enclosure Screen is becoming more popular as an alternative to basic fiberglass screen in patio enclosures, pool enclosures, and lanai's. Even homeowners are recognizing the allure of these strong, color fade resistant screens. GET A FAST QUOTE 904-780-6545 What Exactly is a Screen Enclosure Rescreen? Pool Screen Repair Polyester screen is a screen type that is incredibly stronger than your basic fiberglass screen on most enclosures. Using professional trade skills to remove the old fiber glass screen. This procedure includes the removal of the spline, which holds the screen into the enclosure and causes tension to keep the screen tight and durable. Polyester is a better screen replacement because not only is stronger, it never fades in color, is less likely to tear when pressure washing algae or pollen off the screen and it has a 10-20 year average life span. Give us a call today for an enclosure rescreen with our polyester screen. Why Choose Polyester Instead Of Fiberglass Rescreens? Simply put, our enclosure rescreen services convert a torn up fiberglass screen enclosure into a tighter, more durable and that is strong enough to prevent animals, children, and other accidents from tearing the screen. Elegant and Appealing It looks fantastic and professional. That fresh new look brings a great curb appeal to the overall enclosure. Strong and Long-Lasting Extremely robust and resistant, it can bear the strain and weight of pets, children and pool cleaning accidents. Less Maintenance Polyester screen takes less maintenance, and is simple to clean. Long Life-Span A well-maintained polyester rescreen can last for many years. On average polyester screen lasts between 10 and 20 years in normal conditions. Extremely Cost-Effective Most polyester screen installations are reasonably priced. When you include maintenance expenditures throughout a lifetime, the savings become much more considerable. Insect Screen 17x20 Polyester screen blocks even the smallest bugs from invading your pool or patio areas. Shortest Possible Downtime Our rescreens generally only take between 1 and 3 days depending on the size and height of the enclosure. Improved Durability Another key feature is the thicker mesh of polyester screen allowing it to withstand golf balls, weather and other mishaps that can occur. WHY CHOOSE US LISTEN TO WHAT OUR SATISFIED CLIENTS HAVE TO SAY ABOUT US. ENCLOSURE RESCREEN IN SAINT AUGUSTINE "Our pool enclosure turned out even better than we had dreamed! Excellent quality and the staff were professional, punctual, and responsive to all our questions. I would definitely recommend Panthera Home Services to anyone looking to transform their outdoor space." Henry Theroux ★★★★★ ENCLOSURE RESCREEN IN SAINT AUGUSTINE "Absolutely wonderful service! We had several screen panels blown out thanks to Hurricane Nicole and within minutes of contacting Panthera Home Services, we received a response. Panthera was extremely professional and responsive. They provided a detailed estimate and once we decided on next steps they were able to complete the job within 48 hours. We were extremely pleased with the job and would recommend them to anyone looking for something similar." Cristina Martinez ★★★★★ ENCLOSURE RESCREEN IN SAINT AUGUSTINE "The guys were able to provide next day service to repair several pool screens. They worked quickly, cleaned up afterwards, and overall did a great job at a very fair price." Jeffrey Langenderfer ★★★★★ OUR PROCESS OF Enclosure Rescreens WE TAKE PRIDE IN WHAT WE DO Enclosure Rescreen professionals Saint Augustine, FL To create a clean basis for installing the near rescreen. First we remove all old screen and spline from the enclosure. After all the old spline and screen are removed. Next is to install the new polyester screen with new spline. After the final screen panel is installed. The job is done and you free to immediately enjoy your enclosure. GET A FAST QUOTE 904-780-6545 WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT WE PROVIDE THE BEST ENCLOSURE RESCREENs IN THE INDUSTRY. Fast & Easy Scheduling Our website allows you to book your enclosure rescreen work fast and conveniently. We will do our best to respond as quickly as possible. Fast Competition Time When we plan an enclosure rescreen installation, our goal is to complete the project in three days or less so that you can go back to enjoying your area as soon as possible. Quality Screen Products We utilize screen products that are intended to last up to 20 years or more without color fade or screen blowouts. We provide a long-term service that you can rely on. Reliable and Responsible When you engage with us, you can be certain that you may contact us at any time if you have any questions or concerns about the rescreen job. TIMELINE FOR A TYPICAL RESCREEN PROJECT Rescreen Prep Screen Install Clean Up Removal of all old spline and screen 8:00am - 10:00am Using what's commonly known as a j-hook, place the j-hook within the spline groove of the enclosure. Pull towards the spline edge to remove a few inches of spline. Then with your hand pull tension on the spline to completely remove it from the enclosure. Once all four sides of spline holding the screen into the enclosure are removed you can then pull the old screen and it should easily remove from the enclosure. You'll repeat this process until all the screen is removed from the enclosure. (hint: neatly stack the old screen flat like paper for easier clean up) Get Rescreen Estimate Screen And Spline Install 10:00am - 01:00pm Fill a roller tray with a liner with the epoxy. Cut a line of epoxy around the perimeter of the area to be coated with a 3-inch paintbrush, then paint it into seams and corners. Get Rescreen Estimate Clean up 01:00pm - 03:00pm After all screen is removed and the new screen is installed. The job is nearly complete. The final step is clean up of all old materials that will be bagged and ready for trash removal day. Get Rescreen Estimate GET YOUR FAST QUOTE LET US DO THE DIRTY WORK WORKING WITH US IS EASY AS 1-2-3 1 GET A QUOTE Request a free and quick quotation for your customized project. We will do our best to contact you as soon as possible once you request an estimate. 2 PICK A DAY If you accept our quote, the next step is to choose a time on our calendar that works best for you. We provide flexible and affordable scheduling alternatives. 3 ENJOY YOUR RESCREEN The final step is to relax and enjoy your new gorgeous screen enclosure! HOW DOES POLYESTER SCREEN DIFFER FROM STANDARD FIBERGLASS SCREEN? When it comes down to it, there is no clear way to conclude that one floor coating technology is superior to another. Polyaspartic and epoxy each have advantages and disadvantages, and it is up to you to determine which is a better choice for you. After weighing the benefits and drawbacks of various installation methods, you should have a good idea of what you require for your place. POLYESTER SCREEN (PANTHERA APPROVED) FIBERGLASS SCREEN (MOST COMMON) Installation 1-3+ Days 1-3+ Days Average Screen Life 10-20 Years 3-5 Years UV Durability Sunlight will not cause discoloration or affect strength Will become discolored and brittle over time Applications Pool Enclosures, Patio Enclosures, Lanais Pool Enclosures, Patio Enclosures, Lanais Durability Strong, flexible finish, resistant to tearing, discoloration, blowouts, and abrasion Weak, vulnerable to tearing, discoloration, blowouts, abrasion Overall Strength High Low DIY Installation Not typically available Home Improvement Store, not recommended Overall Quality High Standard Lifetime Cost Less Expensive $ More Expensive $$$ Upfront Price More Expensive $$ Less Expensive $ Frequently Asked Questions ENCLOSURE RESCREEN FAQ WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A PROFESSIONALLY INSTALLED ENCLOSURE RESCREEN AND A HOME IMPROVEMENT STORE DIY KIT? Professional Enclosure screen installers utilize high-strength screen not available to the public, but the DIY kit is typically a basic screen, which is a fiber glass screen that's not built to last. There is also a significant difference in the amount and quality of prep work that experienced installers can do. WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN FIBERGLASS SCREEN AND POLYESTER? Fiberglass screen is made of fiber-glass which is typically thinner and is prone to tear, rip, blowout in storms, or easily be damaged from pets and other occurences. It often loses its color within the first couple years. Fiberglass screen also loses 90% of its strength within the first 5 years. Polyester screen is made to last and can withstand animals pawing at the screen. It withstands heavy winds and storms more efficiently. After 7 years of install the screen only loses 1 percent of it's strength. The average life of polyester screen is 10-20+ years. ARE THERE MANY TYPES OF SCREEN FOR ENCLOSURES? Absolutely. Screen comes in a variety of sorts and brands that vary in price and quality. If you are considering having your enclosure rescreened, be sure that the contractor you choose uses high-quality, fiber-glass free materials. HOW DO YOU GET THE ENCLOSURE READY? The process is simple. We remove the old spline and screen from the enclosure and install new spline and screen. Then we clean up and the enclosure rescreen is finished. WHAT HAPPENS TO THE OLD SCREEN? The old screen and spline is bagged and made ready for trash day. HOW MANY YEARS WILL MY RESCREEN LAST? Polyester Screen will last without color fade or blowouts an average of 10-20+ years. Fiberglass Screen on the otherhand requires more maintenance and only has an average life of 3-5 years before needing another rescreen. HOW LONG WILL THE RESCREEN TAKE? Prepping and rescreen your enclosure might take up to four days depending on the size of the enclosure and amount of debris covering the roof or spline grooves of the enclosure. Average rescreens take us between 1 and 3 days. WHEN WILL I BE ABLE TO USE MY ENCLOSURE AGAIN? When rescreen is complete you'll be able to immediately start using your screen enclosure again. WILL MY PET BE ABLE TO TEAR THROUGH POLYESTER SCREEN? Your pets shouldn't be able to tear through the polyester screen. We do have a 1 year warranty that covers any blown out screen within the first year from a pet. CAN I PRESSURE WASH POLYESTER SCREEN? Though we recommend a softwash, polyester screen is known to hold up much better compared to fiberglass screen when pressure washing. READY TO TRANSFORM YOUR SCREEN ENCLOSURE? We carefully choose which screen products and tools that we use. reviews.text: Highly recommend.  Honest, great work, and reasonable prices.   Will be using them again when the need arises.   Thank you !
reviews.author: Jennifer Scheer

reviews.text: Excellent service. Very prompt and professional. Very reasonably priced. I had most of my screens replaced last year by Sam except for a few. A few days ago, one of the older panels got torn after a storm. Sam promptly came and replaced it before my pool started to get filled with leaves and insects.
reviews.author: Amin Ismail

reviews.text: Sam was a pleasure to deal with!  Got back to me quickly, came at the time he promised, and did an excellent job!  I knew the price before he ever came out because on his website is a chart that makes it very easy to figure out how much your job will be.  He found a couple of panels that needed fixing that I had not noticed, and gave me the option of whether I wanted them repaired or not, absolutely no pressure. I will use this company from now on.  Thanks Sam!
reviews.author: Ralph Sanchez

reviews.text: Cody was friendly,  polite and very efficient installing a screen door access to our patio cover.
reviews.author: Ray Davis

reviews.text: I would like to thank the team who repaired my pool screen.  It looks great.  I will keep your company on my list if I have any other screen issues.
reviews.author: Neal Alexandra

reviews.text: Sam and Jeremiah did an outstanding job replacing the overhead pool screen we lost during Helene. The price was more than fair to anyone like me who has tried this work themselves trying to save money.  They were timely, efficient and very easy to work with.  I highly recommended them!  I will definitely be calling back the next time we need them!
reviews.author: Robert Brogan

reviews.text: Very professional. Was able to come the next day after contacting them. Reasonably priced. And very clean. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: ernesto mercado

reviews.text: We hired Sam and his company to re-screen our entire pool pool area and we couldn't be happier. They did a fantastic job and their customer service is awesome, professional very friendly and made sure the job was done right. I am very happy with the final product. I will definitely recommend them for anyone who need pool enclosure repair or re-screening, they do a wonderful job.
reviews.author: Paul Cabral
